## Analysis

The completed width-10 fringe sweep finished quickly and never beat the seed, so shallow fringes around a solid interval core are now genuinely refuted, not merely undersampled. Across tabu, beam, tempering, and evolution, `sol_0001` remains a robust local optimum; changing optimizers without changing coordinates has produced only ties or regressions. The next search should abandon both single-element coordinates and dense interval cores, using correlated moves that reshape the set’s entire spacing pattern.
